script_text: Stop! Leo, this week the cosmos is humming just for you. Monday’s Mercury trine Jupiter fuels bold ideas—perfect for launching creative projects or signing contracts; write down three goals and act. Tuesday sees Venus square Saturn, urging patience in love; avoid impulsive purchases and nurture steady connections. Wednesday’s Sun sextile Uranus sparks unexpected inspiration—try a new hobby or change a routine to refresh your spirit. Thursday brings Mars opposite Pluto, intensifying inner conflict; channel that energy into a workout or meditation to stay balanced. Friday’s Jupiter conjunct Neptune lifts optimism, making it the best day for big dreams—plan a future adventure or set a visionary vision. Saturday’s Mercury retrograde warns of miscommunication; double‑check messages and keep plans simple. Sunday’s Saturn sextile Mars offers disciplined progress, a solid finish. Best day: Friday. Worst day: Saturday. Trust the stars, Leo, and shine bright! Remember your inner fire.
